title: Near a regular point the support of a current is the regular submanifold
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and every y ∈ reg T (y ∈ regularSet T): there are ρ > 0 and a set M ⊆ ℝ^P such that B_ρ(y) ⊆ U, y ∈ M, M is an embedded C¹ n-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M), H^n(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ B_ρ(y) (H^n := μHE[n]), and spt T ∩ B_ρ(y) = M ∩ B_ρ(y).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y : Euclid P), IsOpen U → y ∈ regularSet T → ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < ρ ∧ ball y ρ ⊆ U ∧ y ∈ M ∧ IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ ball y ρ → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) ∧ T.support ∩ ball y ρ = M ∩ ball y ρ
